name: Shooting Star
source:
This game tells the story of a 23 years old guy who is dissatisfied with his life. After losing his job, the only place he can live is an old classmate, Sofia's apartment.The only problem is that they don’t like each other. Through the eyes of the protagonist, you can get to know Sofia and why she behaves the way she does.
Sometimes you’ll feel bad about the protagonist’s decisions.

[From [url=https://sxrobertvn.itch.io/shooting-star]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
本作讲述一名23岁男子的故事，他对自己的生活感到不满。失去工作后，他唯一能落脚的地方，就是老同学索菲娅的公寓。问题在于，两人彼此都看不顺眼。
通过主角的视角，你将逐渐了解索菲娅，以及她如此行事的原因。
有时，主角做出的决定也会让你感到难受。

[摘自[url=https://sxrobertvn.itch.io/shooting-star]Itch.io[/url]]
